mechanism_narrative: A persistent increase in FEDFUNDS above 4.5% over three consecutive months signals a tightening monetary regime, raising discount rates and reducing present value of future corporate cash flows, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20d forward returns are not significantly negative (< -0.5%) in at least 70% of triggered episodes.

mechanism_narrative: A year-over-year decline in GDPC1 of more than 2% signals weakening aggregate demand, which reduces corporate earnings expectations and depresses equity valuations, resulting in negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 60d forward returns are positive in more than 50% of triggered episodes.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in UNRATE above 6.5% for two consecutive months signals a tight labor market, which increases wage pressure and input costs, ultimately reducing profit margins and leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20d forward returns are not significantly negative (< -0.5%) in at least 60% of triggered months.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained monthly decline in INDPRO of more than 0.5% for three consecutive months signals weakening industrial production, which reduces corporate revenue prospects and leads to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: INDPRO < previous month and < previous month - 0.5% for 3 consecutive months
failure_condition: S&P 500 20d forward returns are positive in more than 40% of triggered episodes.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous monthly decline in both GDPC1 and HOUST signals deteriorating housing and overall demand, which reduces consumer spending and investment, resulting in negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 and HOUST both decline month-over-month
failure_condition: S&P 500 20d forward returns are not significantly negative (< -0.5%) in at least 50% of co-declining episodes.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp decrease in FEDFUNDS below 1% combined with a concurrent rise in CPIAUCSL above 3% signals a mismatch between low policy rates and rising inflation, which erodes real yields and increases uncertainty, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 60d forward returns are not significantly positive (> +0.5%) in at least 60% of triggered episodes.

mechanism_narrative: A persistent monthly increase in PAYEMS above 0.4% for four consecutive months signals robust labor market expansion, which boosts consumer spending and corporate earnings, resulting in positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS > previous month + 0.4% for 4 consecutive months
failure_condition: S&P 500 20d forward returns are not significantly positive (> +0.5%) in at least 55% of triggered episodes.

mechanism_narrative: A persistent monthly increase in RSAFS above 2% for six consecutive months signals accelerating household savings, which may reflect precautionary behavior and reduced consumption, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: RSAFS > previous month + 2% for 6 consecutive months
failure_condition: S&P 500 60d forward returns are not significantly negative (< -0.5%) in at least 50% of triggered episodes.
